## Resume bullets (numbers filled in from this run)
- Analyzed 1.3M+ consumer loan records using SQL and Python to identify key drivers of default across credit grade, income, FICO, and loan purpose.
- Built and compared logistic regression and XGBoost default prediction models (XGBoost best, 0.72 AUC), and segmented borrowers into 5 risk tiers ranging from 5.6% to 40.0% actual default rates.
- Estimated expected loss by risk tier and delivered an Excel risk report and dashboard-ready dataset covering portfolio risk, default trends, and segment performance.
